competing_candidates: The Data Protection Act articles on disclosure of personal data abroad (adequacy, safeguards, exceptions), which set the conditions for the transfer itself rather than what the data subject is told.

gold_facts.text: In answering an access request, the controller must state, where applicable, the recipients or categories of recipients to whom personal data are disclosed.

Where personal data are disclosed abroad, the data subject must be told the name of the state or international body receiving them and, where applicable, the safeguards relied on or the statutory exception applied.
The controller must provide the requested information free of charge, subject to exceptions the Federal Council may provide, in particular for disproportionate effort.
As a rule, the information must be provided within 30 days.

question: I asked an online shop to tell me what it knows about me. I know it hands some of my details to a service company outside Switzerland. When it answers me, what does it have to say about who receives my data and about the foreign destination, and can it charge me or take months to reply?

competing_candidates: The Data Protection Act article on the legal basis required for processing by federal bodies (it sets the general requirement, not the address-data exception).

gold_facts.text: Federal bodies may in principle disclose personal data only if there is a legal basis for it.
On request, federal bodies may disclose a person's surname, first name, address and date of birth even if the general conditions for disclosure are not met.

Federal bodies must refuse, restrict or impose conditions on a disclosure if an important public interest, a manifestly legitimate interest of the data subject, a statutory duty of secrecy or a special data protection provision requires it.

question: Ein Bundesamt hat einer Privatperson auf deren Anfrage mitgeteilt, wie ich heisse, wo ich wohne und wann ich geboren bin. Ich habe nie zugestimmt, und ein Gesetz, das genau das erlaubt, gibt es meines Wissens nicht. Darf eine Bundesbehörde solche Angaben einfach herausgeben, und wann müsste sie es verweigern?

competing_candidates: The Data Protection Act article on restrictions of the right of access, which lists the grounds that this article borrows.
The Data Protection Act article establishing the right to data portability itself.

gold_facts.text: The controller may refuse, restrict or defer the handover or transfer of personal data on the same grounds that allow it to refuse, restrict or defer information under the right of access.
The controller must state the reason for which it refuses, restricts or defers the handover or transfer.

question: J'ai demandé à mon opérateur de téléphonie de me donner mes données dans un fichier que je peux reprendre chez un concurrent, ou de les envoyer directement à ce concurrent. Il refuse sans rien dire. A-t-il le droit de refuser ou de retarder cela, et doit-il au moins m'expliquer pourquoi?

competing_candidates: The Civil Code articles on protection of personality and the Data Protection Act claims against private persons, which do not contain this rule for federal bodies' public collections.

gold_facts.text: Correction, erasure or destruction of personal data cannot be demanded for the holdings of institutions open to the public such as libraries, educational institutions, museums, archives and other public heritage institutions.
If the claimant credibly shows an overriding interest, he or she can require the institution to restrict access to the disputed data.

question: A federal public library keeps an old newspaper in its collection that contains false and embarrassing information about me. Can I force the library to correct or delete that information, and if not, is there anything else I can ask it to do?

gold_facts.text: The controller must inform the data subject of a data security breach when this is necessary for the data subject's protection or when the Federal Data Protection and Information Commissioner requires it.
The controller may restrict, defer or waive informing the data subject where one of the specific grounds on which a federal body may restrict a data subject's right of access applies.
For a federal body, one such ground is that communicating the information is likely to compromise an investigation, an inquiry or judicial or administrative proceedings.

note: Revised per critic: fact 2 narrowed to the federal-body access-restriction grounds the article refers to (no longer any access-restriction ground). Dropped the public-security ground, which the question does not ask.
question: Une administration fédérale a été victime d'un piratage informatique et des dossiers de citoyens ont fuité. Une enquête pénale est en cours et la police craint que prévenir les personnes touchées maintenant ne la fasse échouer. L'administration doit-elle quand même avertir ces personnes, ou peut-elle attendre ou y renoncer?

competing_candidates: The Data Protection Act article on processing by processors, which requires the controller to ensure the processor can guarantee data security.
The Data Protection Act article on data protection by design and by default.

gold_facts.text: Controllers and processors must ensure, through appropriate technical and organisational measures, a level of security of personal data that is adequate to the risk.
The measures must make it possible to avoid data security breaches.
The Federal Council issues provisions on the minimum data security requirements.

question: Ho un piccolo studio di fisioterapia e conservo le schede dei pazienti su un server gestito da una ditta informatica esterna. Che cosa pretende la legge da me e da quella ditta per proteggere questi dati da furti o perdite?

competing_candidates: The Code of Obligations article on the employer's liability for damage caused by employees (it concerns damages, while the question asks to stop and correct the conduct).

gold_facts.text: Where an employee or other auxiliary committed the act of unfair competition in the course of their work, the actions provided for against unfair competition that the article refers to can also be brought against the employer, not only against the employee.

note: Round 2: fact reworded to the reference wording of the gold article, per critic.
question: Un venditore di una ditta concorrente, durante le sue visite ai clienti, racconta che i miei prodotti sono pericolosi, cosa falsa. Per farlo smettere e far chiarire le cose davanti ai clienti, posso agire in giudizio direttamente contro la ditta per cui lavora, oppure solo contro di lui?

gold_facts.text: The federal authorities responsible for enforcing the Unfair Competition Act may cooperate with competent foreign authorities and international organisations or bodies, and in particular coordinate investigations.
This cooperation requires that it is necessary to combat unfair business practices and that the foreign authorities or bodies are bound by official secrecy or an equivalent duty of confidentiality.

note: Revised per critic: removed the fact on Federal Council treaties.
question: Ich bin auf eine Abofalle einer Firma aus dem Ausland hereingefallen, und offenbar betrifft das viele Leute in mehreren Ländern. Dürfen die Bundesbehörden, die in der Schweiz gegen solche Geschäftsmethoden vorgehen, mit den Behörden der anderen Länder zusammenarbeiten und gemeinsam ermitteln, und unter welchen Voraussetzungen?

competing_candidates: The Civil Code article on the general allocation of the burden of proof (it states the default rule, not the shift for advertising claims).

gold_facts.text: The court may require the advertiser to prove the factual accuracy of factual claims made in advertising.
It may do so if this appears appropriate in the individual case, taking into account the legitimate interests of the advertiser and of the other parties to the proceedings.

question: A competitor has sued my company because our TV ad says our vacuum cleaner uses half the electricity of other brands. Normally they would have to prove the ad is wrong, but can the court instead make us prove that what we claim in the ad is actually true?

competing_candidates: The Unfair Competition Act article on the general duty to indicate the actual price to consumers (it covers the selling price, not the unit price for comparison).

gold_facts.text: For measurable goods and services offered to consumers for purchase, the quantity and the price must be indicated.
Their comparability must be ensured by indicating the unit price.
The Federal Council may issue rules whose observance exempts from the duty to indicate the unit price.

question: Au supermarché, le fromage râpé est vendu en sachets de tailles différentes, et l'étiquette n'indique que le prix du sachet. Je n'arrive pas à comparer lequel est le plus avantageux. Le magasin est-il obligé d'indiquer aussi combien coûte par exemple un kilo?

gold_facts.text: The competent cantonal bodies may obtain information and require documents as far as needed to establish the facts.
Persons and firms that offer goods to consumers for purchase are subject to the duty to provide information.
The duty to provide information lapses where testimony may be refused under the Federal Act on Federal Civil Procedure.

Anyone who intentionally breaches the duty to provide information in connection with price indication is liable to a fine of up to 20,000 francs; if the offender acts negligently, the penalty is a fine.

question: Ich führe einen Kiosk. Das kantonale Amt will von mir Auskünfte und Unterlagen dazu, wie ich die Preise meiner Waren anschreibe. Muss ich überhaupt antworten, gibt es Fälle, in denen ich schweigen darf, und was droht mir, wenn ich die Angaben absichtlich verweigere?

competing_candidates: Private bribery offences in the Swiss Criminal Code, which is not among the 8 acts.

gold_facts.text: It is unfair to offer, promise or grant an undue advantage to an employee or other auxiliary of a third party in the private sector to induce an act or omission in breach of duty or within his or her discretion in connection with his or her work.
It is likewise unfair for such an employee or auxiliary to request, accept a promise of or accept an undue advantage for such an act or omission.
Advantages contractually accepted by the third party and minor advantages that are socially customary are not undue.

question: Un fornitore ha regalato al nostro responsabile acquisti un fine settimana in un albergo di lusso perché scegliesse la sua offerta e non quella più conveniente di un altro. Questo è permesso? E i piccoli omaggi di Natale, come una bottiglia di vino, sono un problema?

competing_candidates: The Unfair Competition Act article on unfair general terms and conditions, which protects consumers rather than businesses.

gold_facts.text: An operator of an online platform for booking accommodation services acts unfairly if its general terms and conditions directly or indirectly restrict the price and offer setting of accommodation businesses through parity clauses.
This covers parity clauses concerning price, availability or conditions in particular.

question: Je tiens un petit hôtel à la montagne. La plateforme de réservation en ligne sur laquelle je propose mes chambres m'interdit, dans ses conditions générales, de les offrir moins cher ou à de meilleures conditions sur mon propre site. Est-ce que la plateforme a le droit de m'imposer cela?

gold_facts.text: If a domain name was used to commit a punishable act of unfair competition and this is necessary to prevent further offences, the public prosecutor or the court may order the revocation of a second-level domain name under an internet domain managed by Switzerland, regardless of whether a specific person is punishable.
The authority conducting the proceedings may order the provisional blocking of the domain name until the end of the criminal proceedings.
Anyone who intentionally commits unfair competition is liable on complaint to a custodial sentence of up to three years or a monetary penalty.
Anyone entitled to bring a civil action under the Unfair Competition Act may file the complaint.

question: Un concorrente usa un sito con indirizzo .ch per diffondere di proposito affermazioni false sui miei prodotti, per portarmi via i clienti. Se presento una denuncia penale, si può anche far togliere o bloccare quel dominio? Chi può denunciare e che pena rischia il responsabile?

gold_facts.text: A third party may refuse to cooperate regarding the identity of the author or the content and sources of his or her information if he or she is professionally involved, or an assistant, in publishing information in the editorial part of a periodically published medium.

question: I work as an editor at a weekly news magazine. A company is suing one of its former managers in a civil court, and the court has called me as a witness and wants me to say who leaked the internal documents we reported on. competing_candidates: The mirror opt-out rule in chapter 12 of the Federal Act on Private International Law, which is not among the 8 acts.

gold_facts.text: The arbitration part of the Civil Procedure Code applies to proceedings before arbitral tribunals seated in Switzerland unless chapter 12 of the Federal Act on Private International Law applies.

The parties may, by a declaration in the arbitration agreement or in a later agreement, exclude the arbitration part of the Code and agree that chapter 12 of the Federal Act on Private International Law applies.
That declaration must satisfy statutory formal requirements.

question: Wir sind zwei Schweizer Firmen und haben für Streitigkeiten ein Schiedsgericht mit Sitz in Zürich vereinbart. Gelten dafür automatisch die Regeln der Zivilprozessordnung, oder können wir stattdessen die Regeln wählen, die für internationale Schiedsverfahren gelten, und wie müssten wir das festhalten?

gold_facts.text: If the object in dispute is transferred during the proceedings, the acquirer may take over the proceedings in place of the transferring party.
The party taking over is liable for all court costs, but the withdrawing party remains jointly and severally liable for the court costs incurred up to that point.

question: Pendant mon litige avec un voisin au sujet d'une parcelle de terrain, j'ai vendu ce terrain. L'acheteur peut-il prendre ma place dans la procédure, et qui doit payer les frais, y compris ceux déjà engagés avant la vente ?

competing_candidates: Civil Procedure Code provisions on the main hearing and on the hearing in simplified proceedings.

gold_facts.text: The court may hold instruction hearings at any time.
An instruction hearing serves to discuss the matter in dispute informally, supplement the facts, attempt to reach an agreement between the parties and prepare the main hearing.
The court may take evidence at the instruction hearing.

question: My contract dispute is being handled in ordinary civil proceedings. Before the main hearing, the judge has invited both sides to a meeting. What is such a meeting meant for, and can the judge already hear witnesses or take other evidence there?

competing_candidates: The Civil Procedure Code article allowing the parties to agree that the award may be challenged before the cantonal court instead; excluded here because nothing was agreed.
The Civil Procedure Code articles on revision of an arbitral award, a separate remedy.

gold_facts.text: The arbitral award can be challenged by an appeal to the Federal Supreme Court.
The procedure is governed by the Federal Supreme Court Act unless the arbitration chapter on appeals provides otherwise.

gold_facts.text: The arbitral tribunal may require an advance on the expected costs and make the conduct of the proceedings dependent on its payment.
If a party does not pay its advance, the other party may advance the entire costs or withdraw from the arbitration.
If it withdraws from the arbitration, it may start new arbitration proceedings for the same dispute or bring an action before the state court.

question: In un arbitrato con sede in Svizzera tra la mia ditta e un'altra ditta svizzera, il tribunale arbitrale ha chiesto a ciascuna parte di versare un anticipo per le spese. gold_facts.text: The court instructs the expert and puts the questions for the expert opinion to him or her in writing or orally at a hearing.
The court gives the parties the opportunity to comment on the questions and to propose amendments or additions.
The court makes the necessary files available to the expert and sets a deadline for submitting the report.

question: In my civil lawsuit over defects in my new house, the court is appointing a construction specialist to give an opinion. Do the parties get any say in what exactly the specialist is asked to look into, and does the specialist get a deadline?

gold_facts.text: The conciliation authority examines any documents and may carry out an inspection.

The conciliation authority may submit a proposed judgment to the parties in other financial disputes with a value in dispute of up to 10,000 francs.

question: I filed a claim for an unpaid invoice of 7,000 francs, and first we have to go to the conciliation authority. At that hearing, will they only look at the papers, or can they also hear my witness? And can the authority itself put forward a proposed outcome in a case like mine?
